description: `Capture.Library`, `Exception.Library` were removed in github.com/posthog/posthog-go 2.0.0: code using it fails.
migration_hint: fc05013: Remove `Capture.Library` and `Exception.Library`. Set `$lib` in the event's `Properties` instead, and set `$lib_version` with it: the SDK adds its own version only to its own `$lib`. `posthogmcp` events report `posthog-go-mcp` with the SDK version. See `docs/migration-v2.md`. (github.com/posthog/posthog-go's changelog for 2.0.0)
source_excerpt:
## 2.0.0
Major Changes
- fc05013: Remove `Capture.Library` and `Exception.Library`. Set `$lib` in the event's `Properties` instead, and set `$lib_version` with it: the SDK adds its own version only to its own `$lib`. `posthogmcp` events report `posthog-go-mcp` with the SDK version. See `docs/migration-v2.md`.
